crossRefs.note: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of…
Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.
When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

translations.web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
translations.bsb: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
translations.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest
translations.asv: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
